# BK7258 Worktree Build

## Complete workflow

Prefer the bundled end-to-end wrapper. Without `--flash` it performs the safe
build, L1 validation, package, independent decode, and package-integrity gate:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --workspace <openvela-workspace> \
  --worktree <feature-worktree> \
  --jobs 12
```

The wrapper derives one stable slot per worktree under
`cmake_out/bk7258-worktrees/`. Its `build/cp` and optional `build/ap` directories
are reused for normal Vela incremental builds, and its `package` directory is
safely replaced on each successful package run. A binding file ties the slot to
the canonical workspace/worktree paths, so another worktree cannot reuse it.
If a component defconfig changes, only that component's generated build cache
is recreated. Use `--fresh` to deliberately recreate this worktree's generated
build cache. Use `--slot NAME` only to choose a stable human-readable slot.

To flash, rerun in an interactive terminal and explicitly add `--flash`:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --workspace <openvela-workspace> \
  --worktree <feature-worktree> \
  --flash --device /dev/ttyUSB0
```

To flash an existing verified package without rebuilding or requiring a
workspace/worktree, give the image and the board tools directory explicitly:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --image /absolute/path/to/all-app.bin \
  --tools-dir /absolute/path/to/board/bk7258-devkit/tools \
  --flash --device /dev/ttyUSB0
```

Image-only mode requires `manifest.json` and `decode-report.json` next to the
image. It runs the same independent integrity gate and automatic flash wrapper
but skips build/package. `--worktree <feature-worktree>` may replace
`--tools-dir`; the wrapper then derives `board/bk7258-devkit/tools` from that
worktree.

Flashing is destructive and must use an interactive terminal. The PTY wrapper
streams the loader output without buffering and drives the reset itself: once
the loader prints `connect success`, the wrapper opens the same serial device
as a second writer and injects `reboot bootloader` into the running NSH
console. Target firmware carrying the bootloader-reset patch
(`feature/bk7258-bootloader-reset`, `board_reset`
`ENTER_BOOTLOADER` via AON WDT) then performs a chip-level reset with the
vendor warm-jump tag cleared and the reset reason recorded as watchdog, so
the BootROM runs the cold chain and BL2 opens the download listen window
that the already-polling loader catches by itself -- no manual reset.
`Gotten Bus...` produces the handshake-success banner. If the automatic
reset does not engage within a few seconds (firmware without the patch, a
hung console), the wrapper retries once and then falls back to bell-and-
prompt manual resets, numbered 1, 2, ...; press reset on each prompt and
stop after the success banner. Never press reset after `Begin EraseFlash`,
and never type into the terminal during the automatic phase.

The public workflow assumes a trusted, current-user-owned workspace and Git
worktree. It does not defend against malicious processes running as the same
Unix user, SIGKILL, power loss, or tools that ignore its mapping lock. It never
runs worktree scripts through `sudo` and refuses to
run as root. Give the normal user access to the serial device through the
platform's serial-device group (commonly `dialout`). Before writing, the
wrapper verifies the audited `bk_loader` SHA-256, prints the complete image
SHA-256. The explicit `--flash` flag is the authorization switch. The agent
must still announce the target device and complete image hash in commentary
immediately before launching it.

When an agent launches the flash stage for the user, it must first announce in
commentary the target device, the complete image SHA-256, and that the wrapper
injects `reboot bootloader` automatically (manual-reset fallback prompts
appear only if the auto reset does not engage), then run the command with
interactive terminal support. Never launch `--flash` in the background,
through redirected output, or in a non-interactive shell. Keep the turn open
until `Writing Flash OK` or a clear failure is reported.

The existing board scripts remain the authority: `bk7258-package.sh` must
produce `decode pass`, and `bk7258-flash.sh` must reproduce the report, validate
all hashes, save the loader log, and find `Writing Flash OK`.

## Scope

This workflow is for a BK7258 team-repository worktree whose sources are
linked into the parent OpenVela workspace. The parent workspace is the
directory containing both `build.sh` and `nuttx/`; it is not the team-repository
checkout and not the worktree directory itself.

Never build a BK7258 worktree by passing `board/bk7258-devkit/configs/cp` to
`build.sh`. That path is valid for repository-local Python tools, but
`build.sh`/`lunch` resolves board configs through the manifest path under
`vendor/beken/boards/...`.

## 1. Establish the worktree mapping

For normal worktree builds, use the bundled wrapper; it serializes access to
the shared mapping and restores both links on exit:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/build_worktree.sh \
  --workspace <openvela-workspace> \
  --worktree <feature-worktree> \
  --component cp \
  --jobs 12
```

Use `--component ap` for AP. Use `--output /absolute/output/path` only for an
isolated build whose artifacts will be passed explicitly to packaging.

From the parent OpenVela workspace, verify the mapped paths:

```bash
readlink -f vendor/beken/chips/bk7258
readlink -f vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit
```

For a feature worktree, both targets must resolve into that worktree:

```text
<worktree>/chips/bk7258
<worktree>/board/bk7258-devkit
```

If they point at another checkout, stop and resolve the mapping before
building. In a shared workspace, changing symlinks is visible to other
processes. Prefer a serialized build, save both original link targets, and
restore them in a shell `trap` even when the build fails. Do not delete the
symlink targets or use a broad recursive cleanup.

The project manifest is the source of truth for the normal mapping. The build
tree consumes the mapped `vendor/` paths, while packaging scripts may be run
from the worktree because they locate the workspace by the `build.sh` and
`nuttx/` markers.

## 2. Configure and build CP/AP

Run from the parent workspace. Use the mapped path and keep the trailing slash:

```bash
./build.sh vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit/configs/cp/ --cmake -j12
./build.sh vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit/configs/ap/ --cmake -j12
```

For a CP-only or Wi-Fi-disabled platform change, the first command is the
minimum build. Confirm the generated `.config` does not enable Wi-Fi/WPA when
the acceptance requires a normal CP configuration with Wi-Fi disabled.

`build.sh` derives output names from the board/config selection. Do not add a
random `-b` directory unless the task explicitly needs isolation:

```text
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp/bk7258/app.bin
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp/bk7258/nuttx.elf
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp/bk7258/l1-validation.json
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_ap/bk7258_ap/app1.bin
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_ap/bk7258_ap/l1-validation.json
```

The normal build command supplies the project environment and compiler wrapper.
Direct `cmake --build` can fail with missing `ccache` or stale source paths and
is not equivalent evidence.

## 3. Package and independently decode

The default flow builds and packages the real CP plus OpenVela AP AMP image.
The bundled AP placeholder is recovery-only and must be selected explicitly
with `--placeholder`; it is expected to fail CPU1 AP release validation at
runtime.

For the repository-bundled recovery package, the project wrapper is the
preferred path:

```bash
<worktree>/board/bk7258-devkit/tools/bk7258-package.sh
```

It reads the CP/AP outputs, selects the real OpenVela AP profile, and runs the
independent decoder. The wrapper must print `decode       pass` before an image
is considered valid.

The default package slot intentionally replaces its previous package after the
new CP/AP build and L1 validation pass. `all-app.bin`, `manifest.json`, and
`decode-report.json` remain bound and are verified together before flashing.
Copy that trio elsewhere explicitly when a run must be preserved as historical
hardware evidence.

The package wrapper validates both L1 reports, invokes the container packer,
and independently decodes the final linear-CRC image. Do not flash `app.bin`
or `app1.bin` directly.

## 4. Offline regression checks

Run from the parent workspace or pass paths explicitly:

```bash
python3 <worktree>/board/bk7258-devkit/tests/test_bk7258_bundled_packaging.py
```

The decoder must produce the same report for relative and absolute input paths.
The report normalizes `image.path` with `Path.resolve()`; do not regress this
to the caller's spelling of the path, because evidence hashes and reports must
be stable across invocation directories.

For the vendor-input profile, first validate the machine-local input file and
then run the profile/package test described in
`board/bk7258-devkit/packaging/README.md`. Never invent vendor input paths or
copy credentials into the repository.

## 5. Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `No config file found at` | `build.sh` received `board/...` instead of mapped `vendor/...` path, or the path lacks the expected config directory | Run from the parent workspace with `vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit/configs/cp/` or `ap/` and verify `readlink -f` |
| Early `grep: dor/.../defconfig: No such file` followed by a valid `lunch`, build, and L1 pass | `build.sh` has a non-fatal path-slicing check before `lunch` for full mapped paths | Judge the final command result; do not treat this line alone as failure. A later `No config file found at` or nonzero build result is still a real failure |
| Output builds the wrong source checkout | Shared `vendor/` symlink points at another worktree | Save/replace the two BK7258 links for the build, serialize the operation, and restore them with a trap |
| Image size/config unexpectedly changes while build still passes | A standard CMake output directory retained another worktree's `.config` | Use `full_flow.sh`; its binding prevents cross-worktree cache reuse, and defconfig changes rebuild only the affected component slot |
| `ccache: not found` from direct CMake | Bypassed the environment setup used by `build.sh` | Re-run through `./build.sh ... --cmake` |
| CP image not found during packaging | CP build was not successful or used a custom output directory | Check `cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp/bk7258/app.bin`, its L1 report, and pass `--cp-app-bin` when using `-b` |
| Decoder report differs by working directory | Decoder received relative input and stored it verbatim | Use the current decoder that resolves `args.image`; run the path-stability regression |
| Too many generated directories | A one-shot workflow was used instead of the stable bound slot | Use the default `full_flow.sh`; it incrementally reuses one build slot and replaces one package slot per worktree |
| `Getting Bus...` keeps printing but `Gotten Bus...` never appears, then the manual-reset banner shows up | The automatic `reboot bootloader` did not engage: target firmware lacks the bootloader-reset patch, its console was hung, or the injection window was missed | Press reset on each numbered bell/banner from `notify_flash.py`; stop resetting after `Gotten Bus...`. Deploy `feature/bk7258-bootloader-reset` firmware for the automatic path |
| No reset prompt and no auto-reset banner are visible | Flash was launched without a PTY or through a buffered pipe | Run `full_flow.sh --flash` in an interactive terminal; do not redirect loader stdout |
| `GetBus fail` or `LinkCheck Timeout` | Reset timing, USB, downloader mode, or a busy serial port prevented handshake; Flash has not been erased yet | Close serial monitors and rerun the interactive flash stage |
| Flash refuses root or reports serial permission denied | Public workflow does not execute mutable worktree code as root | Add the user to the serial-device group, re-login, and run without `sudo` |
| Loader SHA-256 mismatch | The bundled proprietary loader differs from the audited repository version | Stop; review the binary change and update the pinned hash only through code review |

A successful host build proves compilation and L1 image validation only. A
passing package/decode proves the linear-CRC container contract. Hardware IRQ,
register readback, GPIO waveform, cold boot, and UART behavior require separate
target evidence and must not be claimed from this workflow alone.

# BK7258 Worktree Build

## Complete workflow

Prefer the bundled end-to-end wrapper. Without `--flash` it performs the safe
build, L1 validation, package, independent decode, and package-integrity gate:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --workspace <openvela-workspace> \
  --worktree <feature-worktree> \
  --jobs 12
```

The wrapper derives one stable slot per worktree under
`cmake_out/bk7258-worktrees/`. Its `build/cp` and optional `build/ap` directories
are reused for normal Vela incremental builds, and its `package` directory is
safely replaced on each successful package run. A binding file ties the slot to
the canonical workspace/worktree paths, so another worktree cannot reuse it.
If a component defconfig changes, only that component's generated build cache
is recreated. Use `--fresh` to deliberately recreate this worktree's generated
build cache. Use `--slot NAME` only to choose a stable human-readable slot.

To flash, rerun in an interactive terminal and explicitly add `--flash`:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --workspace <openvela-workspace> \
  --worktree <feature-worktree> \
  --flash --device /dev/ttyUSB0
```

To flash an existing verified package without rebuilding or requiring a
workspace/worktree, give the image and the board tools directory explicitly:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --image /absolute/path/to/all-app.bin \
  --tools-dir /absolute/path/to/board/bk7258-devkit/tools \
  --flash --device /dev/ttyUSB0
```

Image-only mode requires `manifest.json` and `decode-report.json` next to the
image. It runs the same independent integrity gate and automatic flash wrapper
but skips build/package. `--worktree <feature-worktree>` may replace
`--tools-dir`; the wrapper then derives `board/bk7258-devkit/tools` from that
worktree.

Flashing is destructive and must use an interactive terminal. The PTY wrapper
streams the loader output without buffering and drives the reset itself: once
the loader prints `connect success`, the wrapper opens the same serial device
as a second writer and injects `reboot bootloader` into the running NSH
console. Target firmware carrying the bootloader-reset patch
(`feature/bk7258-bootloader-reset`, `board_reset`
`ENTER_BOOTLOADER` via AON WDT) then performs a chip-level reset with the
vendor warm-jump tag cleared and the reset reason recorded as watchdog, so
the BootROM runs the cold chain and BL2 opens the download listen window
that the already-polling loader catches by itself -- no manual reset.
`Gotten Bus...` produces the handshake-success banner. If the automatic
reset does not engage within a few seconds (firmware without the patch, a
hung console), the wrapper retries once and then falls back to bell-and-
prompt manual resets, numbered 1, 2, ...; press reset on each prompt and
stop after the success banner. Never press reset after `Begin EraseFlash`,

## Scope

This workflow is for a BK7258 team-repository worktree whose sources are
linked into the parent OpenVela workspace. The parent workspace is the
directory containing both `build.sh` and `nuttx/`; it is not the team-repository
checkout and not the worktree directory itself.

Never build a BK7258 worktree by passing `board/bk7258-devkit/configs/cp` to
`build.sh`. That path is valid for repository-local Python tools, but
`build.sh`/`lunch` resolves board configs through the manifest path under
`vendor/beken/boards/...`.

## 1. Establish the worktree mapping

For normal worktree builds, use the bundled wrapper; it serializes access to
the shared mapping and restores both links on exit:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/build_worktree.sh \
  --workspace <openvela-workspace> \
  --worktree <feature-worktree> \
  --component cp \
  --jobs 12
```

Use `--component ap` for AP. Use `--output /absolute/output/path` only for an
isolated build whose artifacts will be passed explicitly to packaging.

From the parent OpenVela workspace, verify the mapped paths:

```bash
readlink -f vendor/beken/chips/bk7258
readlink -f vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit
```

For a feature worktree, both targets must resolve into that worktree:

```text
<worktree>/chips/bk7258
<worktree>/board/bk7258-devkit
```

If they point at another checkout, stop and resolve the mapping before
building. In a shared workspace, changing symlinks is visible to other
processes. Prefer a serialized build, save both original link targets, and
restore them in a shell `trap` even when the build fails. Do not delete the
symlink targets or use a broad recursive cleanup.

The project manifest is the source of truth for the normal mapping. The build
tree consumes the mapped `vendor/` paths, while packaging scripts may be run
from the worktree because they locate the workspace by the `build.sh` and
`nuttx/` markers.

## 2. Configure and build CP/AP

Run from the parent workspace. Use the mapped path and keep the trailing slash:

```bash
./build.sh vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit/configs/cp/ --cmake -j12
./build.sh vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit/configs/ap/ --cmake -j12
```

For a CP-only or Wi-Fi-disabled platform change, the first command is the
minimum build. Confirm the generated `.config` does not enable Wi-Fi/WPA when
the acceptance requires a normal CP configuration with Wi-Fi disabled.

`build.sh` derives output names from the board/config selection. Do not add a
random `-b` directory unless the task explicitly needs isolation:

```text
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp/bk7258/app.bin
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp/bk7258/nuttx.elf
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp/bk7258/l1-validation.json
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_ap/bk7258_ap/app1.bin
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_ap/bk7258_ap/l1-validation.json
```

The normal build command supplies the project environment and compiler wrapper.
Direct `cmake --build` can fail with missing `ccache` or stale source paths and
is not equivalent evidence.

## 3. Package and independently decode

The default flow builds and packages the real CP plus OpenVela AP AMP image.
The bundled AP placeholder is recovery-only and must be selected explicitly
with `--placeholder`; it is expected to fail CPU1 AP release validation at
runtime.

For the repository-bundled recovery package, the project wrapper is the
preferred path:

```bash
<worktree>/board/bk7258-devkit/tools/bk7258-package.sh
```

It reads the CP/AP outputs, selects the real OpenVela AP profile, and runs the
independent decoder. The wrapper must print `decode       pass` before an image
is considered valid.

The default package slot intentionally replaces its previous package after the
new CP/AP build and L1 validation pass. `all-app.bin`, `manifest.json`, and
`decode-report.json` remain bound and are verified together before flashing.
Copy that trio elsewhere explicitly when a run must be preserved as historical
hardware evidence.

The package wrapper validates both L1 reports, invokes the container packer,
and independently decodes the final linear-CRC image. Do not flash `app.bin`
or `app1.bin` directly.

## 4. Offline regression checks

Run from the parent workspace or pass paths explicitly:

```bash
python3 <worktree>/board/bk7258-devkit/tests/test_bk7258_bundled_packaging.py
```

The decoder must produce the same report for relative and absolute input paths.
The report normalizes `image.path` with `Path.resolve()`; do not regress this
to the caller's spelling of the path, because evidence hashes and reports must
be stable across invocation directories.

For the vendor-input profile, first validate the machine-local input file and
then run the profile/package test described in
`board/bk7258-devkit/packaging/README.md`. Never invent vendor input paths or
copy credentials into the repository.

## 5. Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `No config file found at` | `build.sh` received `board/...` instead of mapped `vendor/...` path, or the path lacks the expected config directory | Run from the parent workspace with `vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit/configs/cp/` or `ap/` and verify `readlink -f` |
| Early `grep: dor/.../defconfig: No such file` followed by a valid `lunch`, build, and L1 pass | `build.sh` has a non-fatal path-slicing check before `lunch` for full mapped paths | Judge the final command result; do not treat this line alone as failure. A later `No config file found at` or nonzero build result is still a real failure |
| Output builds the wrong source checkout | Shared `vendor/` symlink points at another worktree | Save/replace the two BK7258 links for the build, serialize the operation, and restore them with a trap |
| Image size/config unexpectedly changes while build still passes | A standard CMake output directory retained another worktree's `.config` | Use `full_flow.sh`; its binding prevents cross-worktree cache reuse, and defconfig changes rebuild only the affected component slot |
| `ccache: not found` from direct CMake | Bypassed the environment setup used by `build.sh` | Re-run through `./build.sh ... --cmake` |
| CP image not found during packaging | CP build was not successful or used a custom output directory | Check `cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp/bk7258/app.bin`, its L1 report, and pass `--cp-app-bin` when using `-b` |
| Decoder report differs by working directory | Decoder received relative input and stored it verbatim | Use the current decoder that resolves `args.image`; run the path-stability regression |
| Too many generated directories | A one-shot workflow was used instead of the stable bound slot | Use the default `full_flow.sh`; it incrementally reuses one build slot and replaces one package slot per worktree |
| `Getting Bus...` keeps printing but `Gotten Bus...` never appears, then the manual-reset banner shows up | The automatic `reboot bootloader` did not engage: target firmware lacks the bootloader-reset patch, its console was hung, or the injection window was missed | Press reset on each numbered bell/banner from `notify_flash.py`; stop resetting after `Gotten Bus...`. Deploy `feature/bk7258-bootloader-reset` firmware for the automatic path |
| No reset prompt and no auto-reset banner are visible | Flash was launched without a PTY or through a buffered pipe | Run `full_flow.sh --flash` in an interactive terminal; do not redirect loader stdout |
| `GetBus fail` or `LinkCheck Timeout` | Reset timing, USB, downloader mode, or a busy serial port prevented handshake; Flash has not been erased yet | Close serial monitors and rerun the interactive flash stage |
| Flash refuses root or reports serial permission denied | Public workflow does not execute mutable worktree code as root | Add the user to the serial-device group, re-login, and run without `sudo` |
| Loader SHA-256 mismatch | The bundled proprietary loader differs from the audited repository version | Stop; review the binary change and update the pinned hash only through code review |

A successful host build proves compilation and L1 image validation only. A
passing package/decode proves the linear-CRC container contract. Hardware IRQ,
register readback, GPIO waveform, cold boot, and UART behavior require separate
target evidence and must not be claimed from this workflow alone.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Tiny BK7258 serial console driver: send lines, capture output."""
import sys
import time
import serial

DEV = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/dev/ttyUSB0"


def main():
    ser = serial.Serial(DEV, 115200, timeout=0.2)
    ser.reset_input_buffer()

    def drain(seconds, label=""):
        end = time.time() + seconds
        out = bytearray()
        while time.time() < end:
            d = ser.read(65536)
            if d:
                out += d
        text = out.decode("utf-8", "replace")
        if label:
            print("--- %s ---" % label, flush=True)
        print(text, end="" if text.endswith("\n") else "\n", flush=True)
        return text

    commands = [c for c in sys.argv[2:]]
    if not commands:
        ser.write(b"\r\n")
        drain(2.0, "probe")
        ser.close()
        return

    for cmd in commands:
        if cmd.startswith("SLEEP:"):
            secs = float(cmd.split(":", 1)[1])
            print("--- sleep %.1fs ---" % secs, flush=True)
            drain(secs)
            continue
        print("\n>>> %s" % cmd, flush=True)
        ser.write(cmd.encode("utf-8") + b"\r\n")
        drain(1.0, "after " + cmd)
    ser.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""E1 reproduction run with full serial logging (keeps the crash head)."""
import re
import time
import serial

LOG = "/tmp/bk_serial_e1.log"
DEV = "/dev/ttyUSB0"

ser = serial.Serial(DEV, 115200, timeout=0.2)
log = open(LOG, "wb")


def pump(seconds, until=None, tag=""):
    end = time.time() + seconds
    hit = False
    while time.time() < end:
        d = ser.read(65536)
        if d:
            log.write(d)
            log.flush()
            if until and until in d:
                hit = True
                break
    print("[pump] %s done=%s hit=%s" % (tag, False, hit), flush=True)
    return hit


def send(cmd):
    print(">>> %s" % cmd, flush=True)
    ser.write(cmd.encode() + b"\r\n")


# Start the app
send("ai_agent")
if not pump(60, until=b"AI Agent ready", tag="boot"):
    print("WARN: AI Agent ready not seen; continuing", flush=True)

time.sleep(1)
send("net_status")
pump(3, tag="net_status")

# E1 message 1
send("ask 你好")
pump(30, tag="ask1")

# give the blocking TTS teardown a chance, then observe stability
pump(10, tag="post1")

# E1 message 2 (previous crash happened around here)
send("ask 你好")
pump(30, tag="ask2")
pump(10, tag="post2")

ser.close()
log.close()

data = open(LOG, "rb").read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
data = re.sub(r"\[lv_nuttx_lcd\][^\n]*\n", "", data)
data = re.sub(r"\[LVGL\] \[[^\n]*\n", "", data)
markers = [
    "agent loop started", "Agent loop started",
    "Processing message", "LLM unavailable", "Agent]:",
    "reply", "speak:", "sched_dumpstack", "Rptun driver reset",
    "Assertion", "assert", "panic", "Up_assert", "backtrace",
    "nsh-ap>", "vela>",
]
print("\n=== marker hits ===")
for m in markers:
    n = data.count(m)
    if n:
        print("%-28s %d" % (m, n))
print("\n=== tail ===")
print(data[-2500:])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""E1/E2 run on the reflashed image: full serial log to /tmp/bk_e1_new.log."""
import re
import time
import serial

LOG = "/tmp/bk_e1_new.log"
ser = serial.Serial("/dev/ttyUSB0", 115200, timeout=0.2)
log = open(LOG, "wb")
allbuf = bytearray()


def pump(seconds, until=None, tag=""):
    end = time.time() + seconds
    hit = False
    while time.time() < end:
        d = ser.read(65536)
        if d:
            log.write(d)
            log.flush()
            allbuf.extend(d)
            if until and until in allbuf:
                hit = True
                break
    print("[pump] %s hit=%s" % (tag, hit), flush=True)
    return hit


def send(cmd):
    print(">>> %s" % cmd, flush=True)
    ser.write(cmd.encode() + b"\r\n")


send("ai_agent")
pump(60, until=b"AI Agent ready", tag="boot")

time.sleep(1)
send("net_status")
pump(3, tag="net_status")

send("ask 你好")
pump(35, tag="ask")

# chat screen yields back to the pet after ~8 s of no new messages
pump(12, tag="idle-yield")

ser.close()
log.close()

data = open(LOG, "rb").read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
data = re.sub(r"\[lv_nuttx_lcd\][^\n]*\n", "", data)

206	static void* ptt_button_thread(void* arg)
207	{
208	  const char* devpath = CONFIG_AI_AGENT_PTT_DEVPATH;
209	  struct btn_pollevents_s pe;
210	  struct pollfd pfd;
211	  btn_buttonset_t supported;
212	  btn_buttonset_t last;
213	  bool have_baseline = false;
214	  int fd;
215	  int bit = ptt_button_bit();
216	
217	  (void)arg;
218	
219	  fd = open(devpath, O_RDONLY);
220	  if (fd < 0)
221	    {
222	      syslog(LOG_ERR, "[%s] open %s failed: %d\n", TAG, devpath, errno);
223	      return NULL;
224	    }
225	
226	  supported = 0;
227	  if (ioctl(fd, BTNIOC_SUPPORTED, (unsigned long)&supported) < 0)
228	    {
229	      syslog(LOG_ERR, "[%s] BTNIOC_SUPPORTED failed: %d\n", TAG, errno);
230	      close(fd);
231	      return NULL;
232	    }
233	
234	  if ((supported & (btn_buttonset_t)bit) == 0)
235	    {
236	      syslog(LOG_ERR, "[%s] button idx %d not in supported set 0x%08lx\n",
237	             TAG, CONFIG_AI_AGENT_PTT_BUTTON_IDX, (unsigned long)supported);
238	      close(fd);
239	      return NULL;
240	    }
241	
242	  /* Wake on both edges of our PTT button only. */
243	  pe.bp_press   = (btn_buttonset_t)bit;
244	  pe.bp_release = (btn_buttonset_t)bit;
245	  (void)ioctl(fd, BTNIOC_POLLEVENTS, (unsigned long)&pe);
246	
247	  pfd.fd     = fd;
248	  pfd.events = POLLIN;
249	  last       = 0;
250	
251	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] watching %s button %d (hold-to-talk)\n", TAG,
252	         devpath, CONFIG_AI_AGENT_PTT_BUTTON_IDX);
253	
254	  for (;;)
255	    {
256	      btn_buttonset_t cur;
257	      btn_buttonset_t change;
258	      ssize_t nread;
259	
260	      if (poll(&pfd, 1, -1) < 0)
261	        {
262	          if (errno == EINTR)
263	            {
264	              continue;
265	            }
266	          syslog(LOG_ERR, "[%s] poll failed: %d\n", TAG, errno);
267	          break;
268	        }
269	
270	      if ((pfd.revents & POLLIN) == 0)
271	        {
272	          continue;
273	        }
274	
275	      nread = read(fd, &cur, sizeof(cur));
276	      if (nread != (ssize_t)sizeof(cur))
277	        {
278	          continue;
279	        }
280	
281	      if (!have_baseline)
282	        {
283	          last = cur;
284	          have_baseline = true;
285	          continue;
286	        }
287	
288	      change = cur ^ last;
289	      if ((change & (btn_buttonset_t)bit) == 0)
290	        {
291	          last = cur;
292	          continue;  /* our button didn't change */
293	        }
294	
295	      if (cur & (btn_buttonset_t)bit)
296	        {
297	          ptt_on_press();
298	        }
299	      else
300	        {
301	          ptt_on_release();
302	        }
303	      last = cur;
304	    }
305	
306	  close(fd);
307	  return NULL;
308	}

# BK7258 Worktree Build

## Complete workflow

Prefer the bundled end-to-end wrapper. Without `--flash` it performs the safe
build, L1 validation, package, independent decode, and package-integrity gate:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --workspace <openvela-workspace> \
  --worktree <feature-worktree> \
  --jobs 12
```

The wrapper derives one stable slot per worktree under
`cmake_out/bk7258-worktrees/`. Its `build/cp` and optional `build/ap` directories
are reused for normal Vela incremental builds, and its `package` directory is
safely replaced on each successful package run. A binding file ties the slot to
the canonical workspace/worktree paths, so another worktree cannot reuse it.
If a component defconfig changes, only that component's generated build cache
is recreated. Use `--fresh` to deliberately recreate this worktree's generated
build cache. Use `--slot NAME` only to choose a stable human-readable slot.

To flash, rerun in an interactive terminal and explicitly add `--flash`:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --workspace <openvela-workspace> \
  --worktree <feature-worktree> \
  --flash --device /dev/ttyUSB0
```

To flash an existing verified package without rebuilding or requiring a
workspace/worktree, give the image and the board tools directory explicitly:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --image /absolute/path/to/all-app.bin \
  --tools-dir /absolute/path/to/board/bk7258-devkit/tools \
  --flash --device /dev/ttyUSB0
```

Image-only mode requires `manifest.json` and `decode-report.json` next to the
image. It runs the same independent integrity gate and automatic flash wrapper
but skips build/package. `--worktree <feature-worktree>` may replace
`--tools-dir`; the wrapper then derives `board/bk7258-devkit/tools` from that
worktree.

Flashing is destructive and must use an interactive terminal. The PTY wrapper
streams the loader output without buffering and drives the reset itself: once
the loader prints `connect success`, the wrapper opens the same serial device
as a second writer and injects `reboot bootloader` into the running NSH
console. Target firmware carrying the bootloader-reset patch
(`feature/bk7258-bootloader-reset`, `board_reset`
`ENTER_BOOTLOADER` via AON WDT) then performs a chip-level reset with the
vendor warm-jump tag cleared and the reset reason recorded as watchdog, so
the BootROM runs the cold chain and BL2 opens the download listen window
that the already-polling loader catches by itself -- no manual reset.
`Gotten Bus...` produces the handshake-success banner. If the automatic
reset does not engage within a few seconds (firmware without the patch, a
hung console), the wrapper retries once and then falls back to bell-and-
prompt manual resets, numbered 1, 2, ...; press reset on each prompt and
stop after the success banner. Never press reset after `Begin EraseFlash`,
and never type into the terminal during the automatic phase.

The public workflow assumes a trusted, current-user-owned workspace and Git
worktree. It does not defend against malicious processes running as the same
Unix user, SIGKILL, power loss, or tools that ignore its mapping lock. It never
runs worktree scripts through `sudo` and refuses to
run as root. Give the normal user access to the serial device through the
platform's serial-device group (commonly `dialout`). Before writing, the
wrapper verifies the audited `bk_loader` SHA-256, prints the complete image
SHA-256. The explicit `--flash` flag is the authorization switch. The agent
must still announce the target device and complete image hash in commentary
immediately before launching it.

When an agent launches the flash stage for the user, it must first announce in
commentary the target device, the complete image SHA-256, and that the wrapper
injects `reboot bootloader` automatically (manual-reset fallback prompts
appear only if the auto reset does not engage), then run the command with
interactive terminal support. Never launch `--flash` in the background,
through redirected output, or in a non-interactive shell. Keep the turn open
until `Writing Flash OK` or a clear failure is reported.

The existing board scripts remain the authority: `bk7258-package.sh` must
produce `decode pass`, and `bk7258-flash.sh` must reproduce the report, validate
all hashes, save the loader log, and find `Writing Flash OK`.

## Scope

This workflow is for a BK7258 team-repository worktree whose sources are
linked into the parent OpenVela workspace. The parent workspace is the
directory containing both `build.sh` and `nuttx/`; it is not the team-repository
checkout and not the worktree directory itself.

Never build a BK7258 worktree by passing `board/bk7258-devkit/configs/cp` to
`build.sh`. That path is valid for repository-local Python tools, but
`build.sh`/`lunch` resolves board configs through the manifest path under
`vendor/beken/boards/...`.

## 1. Establish the worktree mapping

For normal worktree builds, use the bundled wrapper; it serializes access to
the shared mapping and restores both links on exit:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/build_worktree.sh \
  --workspace <openvela-workspace> \
  --worktree <feature-worktree> \
  --component cp \
  --jobs 12
```

Use `--component ap` for AP. Use `--output /absolute/output/path` only for an
isolated build whose artifacts will be passed explicitly to packaging.

From the parent OpenVela workspace, verify the mapped paths:

```bash
readlink -f vendor/beken/chips/bk7258
readlink -f vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit
```

For a feature worktree, both targets must resolve into that worktree:

```text
<worktree>/chips/bk7258
<worktree>/board/bk7258-devkit
```

If they point at another checkout, stop and resolve the mapping before
building. In a shared workspace, changing symlinks is visible to other
processes. Prefer a serialized build, save both original link targets, and
restore them in a shell `trap` even when the build fails. Do not delete the
symlink targets or use a broad recursive cleanup.

The project manifest is the source of truth for the normal mapping. The build
tree consumes the mapped `vendor/` paths, while packaging scripts may be run
from the worktree because they locate the workspace by the `build.sh` and
`nuttx/` markers.

## 2. Configure and build CP/AP

Run from the parent workspace. Use the mapped path and keep the trailing slash:

```bash
./build.sh vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit/configs/cp/ --cmake -j12
./build.sh vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit/configs/ap/ --cmake -j12
```

For a CP-only or Wi-Fi-disabled platform change, the first command is the
minimum build. Confirm the generated `.config` does not enable Wi-Fi/WPA when
the acceptance requires a normal CP configuration with Wi-Fi disabled.

`build.sh` derives output names from the board/config selection. Do not add a
random `-b` directory unless the task explicitly needs isolation:

```text
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp/bk7258/app.bin
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp/bk7258/nuttx.elf
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp/bk7258/l1-validation.json
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_ap/bk7258_ap/app1.bin
cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_ap/bk7258_ap/l1-validation.json
```

The normal build command supplies the project environment and compiler wrapper.
Direct `cmake --build` can fail with missing `ccache` or stale source paths and
is not equivalent evidence.

## 3. Package and independently decode

The default flow builds and packages the real CP plus OpenVela AP AMP image.
The bundled AP placeholder is recovery-only and must be selected explicitly
with `--placeholder`; it is expected to fail CPU1 AP release validation at
runtime.

For the repository-bundled recovery package, the project wrapper is the
preferred path:

```bash
<worktree>/board/bk7258-devkit/tools/bk7258-package.sh
```

It reads the CP/AP outputs, selects the real OpenVela AP profile, and runs the
independent decoder. The wrapper must print `decode       pass` before an image
is considered valid.

The default package slot intentionally replaces its previous package after the
new CP/AP build and L1 validation pass. `all-app.bin`, `manifest.json`, and
`decode-report.json` remain bound and are verified together before flashing.
Copy that trio elsewhere explicitly when a run must be preserved as historical
hardware evidence.

The package wrapper validates both L1 reports, invokes the container packer,
and independently decodes the final linear-CRC image. Do not flash `app.bin`
or `app1.bin` directly.

## 4. Offline regression checks

Run from the parent workspace or pass paths explicitly:

```bash
python3 <worktree>/board/bk7258-devkit/tests/test_bk7258_bundled_packaging.py
```

The decoder must produce the same report for relative and absolute input paths.
The report normalizes `image.path` with `Path.resolve()`; do not regress this
to the caller's spelling of the path, because evidence hashes and reports must
be stable across invocation directories.

For the vendor-input profile, first validate the machine-local input file and
then run the profile/package test described in
`board/bk7258-devkit/packaging/README.md`. Never invent vendor input paths or
copy credentials into the repository.

## 5. Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `No config file found at` | `build.sh` received `board/...` instead of mapped `vendor/...` path, or the path lacks the expected config directory | Run from the parent workspace with `vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit/configs/cp/` or `ap/` and verify `readlink -f` |
| Early `grep: dor/.../defconfig: No such file` followed by a valid `lunch`, build, and L1 pass | `build.sh` has a non-fatal path-slicing check before `lunch` for full mapped paths | Judge the final command result; do not treat this line alone as failure. A later `No config file found at` or nonzero build result is still a real failure |
| Output builds the wrong source checkout | Shared `vendor/` symlink points at another worktree | Save/replace the two BK7258 links for the build, serialize the operation, and restore them with a trap |
| Image size/config unexpectedly changes while build still passes | A standard CMake output directory retained another worktree's `.config` | Use `full_flow.sh`; its binding prevents cross-worktree cache reuse, and defconfig changes rebuild only the affected component slot |
| `ccache: not found` from direct CMake | Bypassed the environment setup used by `build.sh` | Re-run through `./build.sh ... --cmake` |
| CP image not found during packaging | CP build was not successful or used a custom output directory | Check `cmake_out/bk7258-devkit_cp/bk7258/app.bin`, its L1 report, and pass `--cp-app-bin` when using `-b` |
| Decoder report differs by working directory | Decoder received relative input and stored it verbatim | Use the current decoder that resolves `args.image`; run the path-stability regression |
| Too many generated directories | A one-shot workflow was used instead of the stable bound slot | Use the default `full_flow.sh`; it incrementally reuses one build slot and replaces one package slot per worktree |
| `Getting Bus...` keeps printing but `Gotten Bus...` never appears, then the manual-reset banner shows up | The automatic `reboot bootloader` did not engage: target firmware lacks the bootloader-reset patch, its console was hung, or the injection window was missed | Press reset on each numbered bell/banner from `notify_flash.py`; stop resetting after `Gotten Bus...`. Deploy `feature/bk7258-bootloader-reset` firmware for the automatic path |
| No reset prompt and no auto-reset banner are visible | Flash was launched without a PTY or through a buffered pipe | Run `full_flow.sh --flash` in an interactive terminal; do not redirect loader stdout |
| `GetBus fail` or `LinkCheck Timeout` | Reset timing, USB, downloader mode, or a busy serial port prevented handshake; Flash has not been erased yet | Close serial monitors and rerun the interactive flash stage |
| Flash refuses root or reports serial permission denied | Public workflow does not execute mutable worktree code as root | Add the user to the serial-device group, re-login, and run without `sudo` |
| Loader SHA-256 mismatch | The bundled proprietary loader differs from the audited repository version | Stop; review the binary change and update the pinned hash only through code review |

A successful host build proves compilation and L1 image validation only. A
passing package/decode proves the linear-CRC container contract. Hardware IRQ,
register readback, GPIO waveform, cold boot, and UART behavior require separate
target evidence and must not be claimed from this workflow alone.

---
name: lvgl-ui-no-os-cross-thread-race
description: AP LVGL 构建 CONFIG_LV_USE_OS=0 无锁,跨线程 lv_async_call 撞上 handler 会执行半初始化 timer(垃圾 user_data)→ Unaligned UsageFault → CP panic 复位 AP
metadata:
  type: project
---

BK7258 AP 的 LVGL 构建是 `CONFIG_LV_USE_OS=0`（`lv_conf_internal.h` 落到 `LV_OS_NONE`），**LVGL 内部零加锁**：timer 链表、对象树、lv_malloc 堆都是裸全局量。而 `lv_loop_thread()` 在独立线程跑 `lv_timer_handler()`，agent 循环/outbound/PTT/命令通道等线程都通过 `lv_async_call()` / `lv_timer_create()` 进 LVGL。

`lv_timer_create()`（`apps/graphics/lvgl/lvgl/src/misc/lv_timer.c`）先把新 timer 链进全局链表（`_lv_ll_ins_head`），**之后**才逐字段赋值，`user_data` 在最后。无锁时 handler 可能遍历到这个半成品：`timer_cb` 已就绪而 `user_data` 还是堆里旧垃圾。真机实测（2026-10-20，`ask` 无网路径）崩在 `lv_async_timer_cb` 的 `ldmia.w r2,{r0,r1}`（`lv_async.c:103`），CFSR=0x01000000（ARMv8-M 只有 LDM/STM 类未对齐访问才报 UNALIGNED），RPTUN 随即 `Panic by remote core: ap` + reset reason 2。同一路径上每多一个 `lv_async_call()` 命中率就翻倍，所以"新增一个异步 UI 更新"会表现为"突然稳定复现崩溃"。

**修复**（`packages/ai_agent/src/ui/lvgl_ui_channel.c`）：`lvgl_ui_lock/lvgl_ui_unlock` 用 owner+depth 模拟可重入（本构建 `CONFIG_PTHREAD_MUTEX_TYPES` 未开，`PTHREAD_RECURSIVE_MUTEX_INITIALIZER_NP` 不存在）；`lv_loop_thread` 在 `lv_timer_handler()` 外围持锁；所有跨线程 `lv_async_call()` 改走 `lvgl_ui_async_call()`；自起 LVGL 时 loop 线程改到 init 末尾启动。**Why:** 这些全局量并发访问就是内存破坏，症状离根因很远（UsageFault 在 LVGL 内部）。**How to apply:** 以后任何新 UI 代码，只要不在 LVGL 线程里，就禁用裸 `lv_async_call()`/`lv_timer_create()`/`lv_obj_*`，统一走加锁封装；排查 AP panic 先看 `dump_assert_info` 的 CFSR 与 `sched_dumpstack` 回溯，再用 AP `System.map` addr2line。

上一轮真机测试的结论已经查清,并已修复、重新出包。

## 上一轮为什么崩

串口日志里 AP 已经给出了完整证据:

```
arm_usagefault: PANIC!!! Usage Fault:
arm_usagefault:   CFSR: 01000000 ... (Unaligned access)
dump_assert_info: ... arm_usagefault.c:114 task: ai_agent
[CP] FATAL: Panic by remote core: ap   → reset reason 2
```

用 AP `System.map` 把 `sched_dumpstack` 的回溯符号化后,链路是:

`lv_loop_thread → lv_timer_handler → lv_timer_exec → lv_async_timer_cb → lv_async.c:103`

`lv_async.c:103` 反汇编正好是 `ldmia.w r2, {r0,r1}`(r2 = `timer->user_data`)。ARMv8-M 上普通 LDR 允许非对齐,**只有 LDM/STM 这类多寄存器访问会报 UNALIGNED** —— 说明 `user_data` 变成了垃圾指针。

根因是 LVGL 的线程竞态,不是中文文案:

- AP 的 LVGL 构建是 `CONFIG_LV_USE_OS=0`,LVGL 内部**完全没有锁**;
- `lv_timer_create()` 先把新 timer 链进全局链表(`lv_timer.c:165`),**之后**才逐字段赋值,`user_data` 最后才写;
- 与此同时 LVGL 循环线程正在 `lv_timer_handler()` 遍历同一链表 → 执行到一个"字段还没填完"的 timer,`timer_cb` 已就绪、`user_data` 还是堆里的旧垃圾 → `ldmia` 未对齐 → UsageFault → RPTUN 判 AP panic 并复位。

这个竞态一直存在,但这次"宠物屏显示具体原因"在同一回复路径上**新增了第二个 `lv_async_call`**,命中窗口直接翻倍,所以表现为"一 `ask` 就崩"。

## 已做的修复

- [lvgl_ui_channel.c](packages/ai_agent/src/ui/lvgl_ui_channel.c):新增 `lvgl_ui_lock()/lvgl_ui_unlock()`(owner+depth 模拟可重入,本构建未开 `CONFIG_PTHREAD_MUTEX_TYPES`)和加锁版 `lvgl_ui_async_call()`;`lv_loop_thread()` 在 `lv_timer_handler()` 外围持锁;
- 自起 LVGL 时把 loop 线程创建挪到 `init` 末尾,控件全部建好后再起 handler 线程;
- 所有跨线程异步入口改走加锁封装:[pet_status_view.c](packages/ai_agent/src/ui/pet_status_view.c)、[standby_view.c](packages/ai_agent/src/ui/standby_view.c)、[particle_flow_view.c](packages/ai_agent/src/ui/particle_flow_view.c)、[lvgl_toast.c](packages/ai_agent/src/ui/lvgl_toast.c)、[qrcode_display.c](packages/ai_agent/src/ui/qrcode_display.c)(其 `lv_timer_create` 也持锁)。

10	
11	BK7258 AP 的 LVGL 构建是 `CONFIG_LV_USE_OS=0`（`lv_conf_internal.h` 落到 `LV_OS_NONE`），**LVGL 内部零加锁**：timer 链表、对象树、lv_malloc 堆都是裸全局量。而 `lv_loop_thread()` 在独立线程跑 `lv_timer_handler()`，agent 循环/outbound/PTT/命令通道等线程都通过 `lv_async_call()` / `lv_timer_create()` 进 LVGL。
12	
13	`lv_timer_create()`（`apps/graphics/lvgl/lvgl/src/misc/lv_timer.c`）先把新 timer 链进全局链表（`_lv_ll_ins_head`），**之后**才逐字段赋值，`user_data` 在最后。无锁时 handler 可能遍历到这个半成品：`timer_cb` 已就绪而 `user_data` 还是堆里旧垃圾。真机实测（2026-10-20，`ask` 无网路径）崩在 `lv_async_timer_cb` 的 `ldmia.w r2,{r0,r1}`（`lv_async.c:103`），CFSR=0x01000000（ARMv8-M 只有 LDM/STM 类未对齐访问才报 UNALIGNED），RPTUN 随即 `Panic by remote core: ap` + reset reason 2。同一路径上每多一个 `lv_async_call()` 命中率就翻倍，所以"新增一个异步 UI 更新"会表现为"突然稳定复现崩溃"。
14	
15	**修复**（`packages/ai_agent/src/ui/lvgl_ui_channel.c`）：`lvgl_ui_lock/lvgl_ui_unlock` 用 owner+depth 模拟可重入（本构建 `CONFIG_PTHREAD_MUTEX_TYPES` 未开，`PTHREAD_RECURSIVE_MUTEX_INITIALIZER_NP` 不存在）；`lv_loop_thread` 在 `lv_timer_handler()` 外围持锁；所有跨线程 `lv_async_call()` 改走 `lvgl_ui_async_call()`；自起 LVGL 时 loop 线程改到 init 末尾启动。**Why:** 这些全局量并发访问就是内存破坏，症状离根因很远（UsageFault 在 LVGL 内部）。**How to apply:** 以后任何新 UI 代码，只要不在 LVGL 线程里，就禁用裸 `lv_async_call()`/`lv_timer_create()`/`lv_obj_*`，统一走加锁封装；排查 AP panic 先看 `dump_assert_info` 的 CFSR 与 `sched_dumpstack` 回溯，再用 AP `System.map` addr2line。
16

230	#### F. AP UsageFault 崩溃 → CP panic(2026-10-20 定位并修复)
231	
232	**现象**:`ask 你好` 后只看到 `[agent] Processing message from cli:console`,随即 AP 死:
233	
234	```
235	arm_usagefault: PANIC!!! Usage Fault:
236	arm_usagefault:     CFSR: 01000000 ... (Unaligned access)
237	dump_assert_info: Assertion failed panic: at file: .../arm_m/arm_usagefault.c:114 task: ai_agent
238	[CP] FATAL: Panic by remote core: ap
239	Rptun driver reset remote ap reason: 2
240	```
241	
242	AP 回溯(`sched_dumpstack`)落在 `lv_loop_thread → lv_timer_handler →
243	lv_timer_exec → lv_async_timer_cb → lv_async.c:103`。反汇编 `lv_async_timer_cb`
244	在 `lv_async.c:103` 是 `ldmia.w r2, {r0,r1}`(r2 = `timer->user_data`),
245	ARMv8-M 上只有 LDM/STM 这类多寄存器访问会因未对齐触发 UsageFault —— 也就是
246	**user_data 指针是垃圾值**。
247	
248	**根因**:AP 构建 `CONFIG_LV_USE_OS=0`,LVGL 自身没有任何锁。`lv_timer_create()`
249	(`lv_timer.c:165`)先把新 timer **链进全局链表**,到第 174 行才写 `user_data`;
250	与此同时 LVGL 循环线程正在 `lv_timer_handler()` 遍历同一链表。agent 线程
251	`lv_async_call()`(本次修复又在这条路径上新增了第二个 `lv_async_call`,命中率大增)
252	撞上这个窗口:handler 执行了一个刚链入、字段还没填完的 timer,`timer_cb` 已就绪
253	而 `user_data` 还是堆里的旧垃圾 → `ldmia` 未对齐 → UsageFault → RPTUN 把 AP 复位。
254	
255	**修复**(`packages/ai_agent/src/ui/lvgl_ui_channel.c` 等):
256	- 新增 `lvgl_ui_lock()/lvgl_ui_unlock()`(owner+depth 模拟可重入,本构建未开
257	  `CONFIG_PTHREAD_MUTEX_TYPES`)与加锁版 `lvgl_ui_async_call()`;
258	- `lv_loop_thread()` 在 `lv_timer_handler()` 外围持锁;
259	- 所有跨线程 `lv_async_call()`(lvgl_ui_channel / pet_status_view / standby_view /
260	  particle_flow_view / lvgl_toast / qrcode_display / tool_proxyquickapp)统一改用
261	  `lvgl_ui_async_call()`;`qrcode_display` 的 `lv_timer_create` 也持锁;
262	- 自起 LVGL 时把 loop 线程的创建**挪到 init 末尾**(控件全部建好之后再起 handler
263	  线程),消除启动期同一批 LVGL 全局量的竞争。
264

267	`[agent] reply 60 bytes`,8s 后 `[lvgl_ui] idle → pet home screen`,宠物屏文字为

# BK7258 Worktree Build

## Complete workflow

Prefer the bundled end-to-end wrapper. Without `--flash` it performs the safe
build, L1 validation, package, independent decode, and package-integrity gate:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --workspace <openvela-workspace> \
  --worktree <feature-worktree> \
  --jobs 12
```

The wrapper derives one stable slot per worktree under
`cmake_out/bk7258-worktrees/`. Its `build/cp` and optional `build/ap` directories
are reused for normal Vela incremental builds, and its `package` directory is
safely replaced on each successful package run. A binding file ties the slot to
the canonical workspace/worktree paths, so another worktree cannot reuse it.
If a component defconfig changes, only that component's generated build cache
is recreated. Use `--fresh` to deliberately recreate this worktree's generated
build cache. Use `--slot NAME` only to choose a stable human-readable slot.

To flash, rerun in an interactive terminal and explicitly add `--flash`:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --workspace <openvela-workspace> \
  --worktree <feature-worktree> \
  --flash --device /dev/ttyUSB0
```

To flash an existing verified package without rebuilding or requiring a
workspace/worktree, give the image and the board tools directory explicitly:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/full_flow.sh \
  --image /absolute/path/to/all-app.bin \
  --tools-dir /absolute/path/to/board/bk7258-devkit/tools \
  --flash --device /dev/ttyUSB0
```

Image-only mode requires `manifest.json` and `decode-report.json` next to the
image. It runs the same independent integrity gate and automatic flash wrapper
but skips build/package. `--worktree <feature-worktree>` may replace
`--tools-dir`; the wrapper then derives `board/bk7258-devkit/tools` from that
worktree.

Flashing is destructive and must use an interactive terminal. The PTY wrapper
streams the loader output without buffering and drives the reset itself: once
the loader prints `connect success`, the wrapper opens the same serial device
as a second writer and injects `reboot bootloader` into the running NSH
console. Target firmware carrying the bootloader-reset patch
(`feature/bk7258-bootloader-reset`, `board_reset`
`ENTER_BOOTLOADER` via AON WDT) then performs a chip-level reset with the
vendor warm-jump tag cleared and the reset reason recorded as watchdog, so
the BootROM runs the cold chain and BL2 opens the download listen window
that the already-polling loader catches by itself -- no manual reset.
`Gotten Bus...` produces the handshake-success banner. If the automatic
reset does not engage within a few seconds (firmware without the patch, a
hung console), the wrapper retries once and then falls back to bell-and-
prompt manual resets, numbered 1, 2, ...; press reset on each prompt and
stop after the success banner. Never press reset after `Begin EraseFlash`,
and never type into the terminal during the automatic phase.

The public workflow assumes a trusted, current-user-owned workspace and Git
worktree. It does not defend against malicious processes running as the same
Unix user, SIGKILL, power loss, or tools that ignore its mapping lock. It never
runs worktree scripts through `sudo` and refuses to
run as root. Give the normal user access to the serial device through the
platform's serial-device group (commonly `dialout`). Before writing, the
wrapper verifies the audited `bk_loader` SHA-256, prints the complete image
SHA-256. The explicit `--flash` flag is the authorization switch. The agent
must still announce the target device and complete image hash in commentary
immediately before launching it.

When an agent launches the flash stage for the user, it must first announce in
commentary the target device, the complete image SHA-256, and that the wrapper
injects `reboot bootloader` automatically (manual-reset fallback prompts
appear only if the auto reset does not engage), then run the command with
interactive terminal support. Never launch `--flash` in the background,
through redirected output, or in a non-interactive shell. Keep the turn open
until `Writing Flash OK` or a clear failure is reported.

The existing board scripts remain the authority: `bk7258-package.sh` must
produce `decode pass`, and `bk7258-flash.sh` must reproduce the report, validate
all hashes, save the loader log, and find `Writing Flash OK`.

## Scope

This workflow is for a BK7258 team-repository worktree whose sources are
linked into the parent OpenVela workspace. The parent workspace is the
directory containing both `build.sh` and `nuttx/`; it is not the team-repository
checkout and not the worktree directory itself.

Never build a BK7258 worktree by passing `board/bk7258-devkit/configs/cp` to
`build.sh`. That path is valid for repository-local Python tools, but
`build.sh`/`lunch` resolves board configs through the manifest path under
`vendor/beken/boards/...`.

## 1. Establish the worktree mapping

For normal worktree builds, use the bundled wrapper; it serializes access to
the shared mapping and restores both links on exit:

```bash
<skill-dir>/scripts/build_worktree.sh \
  --workspace <openvela-workspace> \
  --worktree <feature-worktree> \
  --component cp \
  --jobs 12
```

Use `--component ap` for AP. Use `--output /absolute/output/path` only for an
isolated build whose artifacts will be passed explicitly to packaging.

From the parent OpenVela workspace, verify the mapped paths:

```bash
readlink -f vendor/beken/chips/bk7258
readlink -f vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-devkit
```

For a feature worktree, both targets must resolve into that worktree:

```text
<worktree>/chips/bk7258
<worktree>/board/bk7258-devkit
```

If they point at another checkout, stop and resolve the mapping before
building. In a shared workspace, changing symlinks is visible to other
processes. Prefer a serialized build, save both original link targets, and
restore them in a shell `trap` even when the build fails. Do not delete the
symlink targets or use a broad recursive cleanup.

The project manifest is the source of truth for the normal mapping. The build

from the worktree because they locate the workspace by the `build.sh` and
`nuttx/` markers.

Run from the parent workspace. Use the mapped path and keep the trailing slash:


For a CP-only or Wi-Fi-disabled platform change, the first command is the

`build.sh` derives output names from the board/config selection. Do not add a

## 3. Package and independently decode

The default flow builds and packages the real CP plus OpenVela AP AMP image.
The bundled AP placeholder is recovery-only and must be selected explicitly
with `--placeholder`; it is expected to fail CPU1 AP release validation at
runtime.

For the repository-bundled recovery package, the project wrapper is the
preferred path:

```bash

```

It reads the CP/AP outputs, selects the real OpenVela AP profile, and runs the
independent decoder. The wrapper must print `decode       pass` before an image
is considered valid.

The default package slot intentionally replaces its previous package after the
new CP/AP build and L1 validation pass. `all-app.bin`, `manifest.json`, and
`decode-report.json` remain bound and are verified together before flashing.
Copy that trio elsewhere explicitly when a run must be preserved as historical
hardware evidence.

The package wrapper validates both L1 reports, invokes the container packer,
and independently decodes the final linear-CRC image. Do not flash `app.bin`
or `app1.bin` directly.

## 4. Offline regression checks

The decoder must produce the same report for relative and absolute input paths.

For the vendor-input profile, first validate the machine-local input file and

## Acceptance boundary

A successful host build proves compilation and L1 image validation only. A
passing package/decode proves the linear-CRC container contract. Hardware IRQ,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""E1/E2 acceptance on the lock-fix image: offline `ask`, capture serial."""
import re
import sys
import time
import serial

DEV = "/dev/ttyUSB0"
LOG = "/tmp/bk_e1_lockfix2.log"
buf = bytearray()

s = serial.Serial(DEV, 115200, timeout=0.2)


def pump(seconds, note=""):
    end = time.time() + seconds
    while time.time() < end:
        try:
            data = s.read(4096)
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            print(f"[pump] read error: {e}")
            return
        if data:
            buf.extend(data)
    if note:
        print(f"[pump] {note}: total {len(buf)} bytes")


def tail_text(n=2500):
    return bytes(buf[-n:]).decode("utf-8", "replace")


print("== drain 2s ==")
pump(2)
print(tail_text(1200))

# Make sure we are at a prompt
s.write(b"\r\n")
pump(2)
text = bytes(buf).decode("utf-8", "replace")
print("== after CRLF ==")
print(tail_text(800))

if "ai_agent" not in text[-400:] and "vela>" not in text[-400:]:
    print("== sending ai_agent ==")
    s.write(b"ai_agent\r\n")
    # wait up to 90s for the UI to come up
    end = time.time() + 90
    while time.time() < end:
        pump(1)
        t = bytes(buf[-4000:]).decode("utf-8", "replace")
        if "vela>" in t or "Agent loop started" in t:
            break
    print("== after ai_agent ==")
    print(tail_text(2000))

# let startup settle
pump(3)

print("== sending: ask 你好 ==")
s.write("ask 你好\r\n".encode("utf-8"))
pump(75, "post-ask capture")

s.close()
data = bytes(buf)
with open(LOG, "wb") as f:
    f.write(data)
print(f"== saved {len(data)} bytes to {LOG} ==")

text = data.decode("utf-8", "replace")
checks = [
    "Processing message from cli:console",
    "LLM unavailable",
    "reply 60 bytes",
    "speak:",
    "idle → pet home screen",
    "idle -> pet home screen",
    "arm_usagefault",
    "Panic by remote core",
    "FATAL",
    "Agent loop started",
]
print("== key line check ==")
for c in checks:
    print(f"{'YES' if c in text else 'no '}  {c}")

# print the interesting window
m = re.search(r"Sent to agent", text)
if m:
    start = max(0, m.start() - 200)
    print("== window around ask ==")
    print(text[start:start + 6000])
else:
    print("== last 4000 chars ==")
    print(text[-4000:])

# BK7258 AP 侧网络应用复盘（TLS / LLM / NTP）

接在 `bk7258-network-bringup-retrospective.md` 之后：那份解决的是 CP 上 wlan0 从扫描到 ping 通，这份解决的是 AP 上的应用经 usrsock 用这条链路时遇到的问题。

## 现在到哪了

AP 上的 ai_agent 经 RPMsg usrsock 使用 CP 的 NuttX 协议栈：TLS 握手、10 KB 级请求体、LLM 回复、NTP 对时都在板上跑通。`ask` 的端到端耗时约 14 秒，其中大部分是服务端生成时间。

相关提交：

| 仓库 | commit | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| 本仓库 | `7846afc` | TLS 单条记录上限 4096、NTP 守护任务栈 4096、`STACK_COLORATION` |
| 本仓库 | `60776fc` | AP rpmsg 工作队列栈 8192 |
| 本仓库 | `10157a9` | AP `SYSLOG_INTBUFFER` |
| `packages/ai_agent` | `6b48fe3` | `set_llm` 路径补全 |
| `apps`（本地分支 `fix/ntpclient-icmp-timeout`） | `2d34eff73` | ntpclient 连通性 ping 超时，待提上游 PR |

`apps` 那个提交只在本地。`apps` 切回别的分支，AP 上的 NTP 会悄悄失效。

## 根因清单

### 1. TLS 大写入卡死：usrsock 请求占满 rptun 环（`7846afc`）

症状：握手成功，写 10659 字节的请求体时停在 `DIAG net_send calling len=10659`，之后再无输出，也没有报错。

根因：`nuttx/drivers/usrsock/usrsock_rpmsg_server.c:455-519` 收到 sendto 请求的每个分片都 `rpmsg_hold_rx_buffer` 扣住，直到整个请求拼完才释放。AP→CP 方向只有 `VRING_NUM=4` 块、每块约 2032 字节净载，这个请求要 6 块。第 4 块被扣住后 ring 里没有空闲缓冲，AP 在 `rpmsg_get_tx_payload_buffer(wait=true)` 里无限等，CP 永远等不到剩下的分片。CP 只在用完第 `NIOVEC` 个 iov 时才报 `Request too large`，所以连这句报错都没有。

单次请求的真实上限是 `min(NIOVEC, VRING_NUM) × 约 2032` 字节，还要减去同时在发的其他 socket 占用。项目记忆里原来写的"NIOVEC=16，上限约 30 KB"是错的。

修法：`ap-armino/defconfig` 加 `CONFIG_MBEDTLS_SSL_OUT_CONTENT_LEN=4096`，一条 TLS 记录约 4.1 KB，占 3 块。`vela_tls.c` 的写循环本来就处理部分写入，所以 body 不会被截断。`IN_CONTENT_LEN` 保持 16384：服务器可以发 16 KB 的记录，而 CP→AP 方向 CP 会主动分片，没有这个问题。顺带省下约 12 KB RAM。

判据：10638 字节分成 `4117 + 4117 + 2467` 三条记录发出，服务器回包。

### 2. LLM 404：两个独立原因（`6b48fe3`）

第一个是路径补全太死。`cmd_llm.c` 只在路径正好是 `/v1` 时补 `/chat/completions`。`/compatible-mode/v1`、`/api/v3` 都被原样请求，网关返回空 body 的 404。现在的规则是：最后一段是 `v<数字>` 才补；完整路径、`/v1/messages`、`/v1beta` 都不动。规则在 `src/channels/llm_path.h`，主机测试是 `tests/host/test_llm_path.c`。

第二个是拼写错误。有一次 URL 写成了 `chat/cpmpletions`。终端没开自动换行，那一行被截断，看不到。

另外，`/api/v3/responses` 是 Responses API，请求体字段是 `input`。ai_agent 只会生成 Chat Completions 格式（`messages`），所以那次的报错是 400 `unknown field "messages"`，不是 404。

### 3. 正常回复被当成超时

症状：`LLM watchdog: call took 4183107793 ms`，回复已经收到，却被当成超时丢弃。

根因：`vela_tls.c` 发现系统时间早于 2024 年时，会在请求进行中把时钟强制拨到 2026 年。agent 用 `gettimeofday` 计时，差值就变成了约 48 天。只在开机后 NTP 同步之前的第一次请求出现。

修法：根治靠 NTP 在第一次请求前同步好，见下一条。agent 计时改成 `CLOCK_MONOTONIC` 属于上游修改，没有做。

### 4. NTP 从不同步：两个独立根因（`apps` `2d34eff73` + `7846afc`）

症状：`ntpcstatus` 一直是 0 个样本。开网络调试后，有时还会整个 AP 卡死，NSH 不能输入，`[AP] stalled`。

**4a. 连通性检查的 ping 只等 1 毫秒。** ntpclient 每轮先调 `netlib_check_ipconnectivity(NULL, 1, 1)` ping 一下 DNS 服务器，ping 不通就不发 NTP 请求。`icmp_ping` 的超时单位是毫秒：`system/ping/ping.c:47` 默认传 1000 并注释"1 second in milliseconds"，`icmp_ping.c:356` 直接把它交给 `poll`。但 `icmp_ping.h` 的注释写的是 deciseconds，ntpclient 传了 1。实际网络 RTT 是 45–59 ms，几乎每轮都失败。改成 1000，并把头文件注释改为毫秒。

**4b. NTP 守护任务栈溢出。** 守护任务栈只有 2048 字节，它自己做 DNS 解析，`lib_dnsquery.c` 在栈上放 `qname[258]` 加约 512 字节的收发缓冲。开 `STACK_COLORATION` 后 `ps` 显示实际用了 2108 字节，而可用约 1990 字节。偶尔 4a 的 ping 赶上了回包，流程走到 DNS，就会栈溢出，表现为卡死或 panic。改为 `CONFIG_NETUTILS_NTPCLIENT_STACKSIZE=4096`，现在用量 52.7%。

为什么卡死时整个 AP 都不动：守护线程从 `ntpclient.c:1290` 起整个循环都持有 `sched_lock()`。AP 是单核，线程一旦在不阻塞的状态下出问题，其他任务都排不上，包括心跳线程和 NSH。这是 ntpclient 的上游设计，我们没改。

还没处理：`NETUTILS_NTPCLIENT_SERVER` 里 `ntp1.ntsc.ac.cn`、`ntp1.cstnet.cn` 在这个网络上解析不了，现在只靠 `ntp1.aliyun.com`。

### 5. AP 在中断里写 syslog 触发断言（`10157a9`）

症状：在 mailbox 中断里执行 `syslog()` 时，断言在 `semaphore.h:518`。

根因：AP 的 syslog channel 是 RPMsg console。它的写函数要拿 `nxmutex`，中断写和普通写用的是同一个函数（`g_syslog_dev_ops`），没有中断安全的路径。

修法：`CONFIG_SYSLOG_INTBUFFER=y`、`CONFIG_SYSLOG_INTBUFSIZE=1024`。中断里的输出先放进缓冲，回到任务上下文或 panic flush 时再写出去。

剩余风险：缓冲满了以后 NuttX 改为强制直写（`syslog_intbuffer.c` 的溢出分支），又会碰到互斥锁。只有中断里短时间连续写超过 1 KB 才会触发。

### 6. AP rpmsg 工作队列栈接近满（`60776fc`）

console 移到 AP 之后，`ps` 显示 `rpmsg-cp-0` 用了 3588 / 4016 字节（89%）。`CONFIG_RPMSG_WQUEUE_STACKSIZE=8192` 之后是 11.7%。和 4b 是同一类风险，提前处理。

## 设计决策：保留 usrsock，不改 VNET

问题：AP 和 CP 之间用 usrsock（转发 socket 调用），还是用虚拟网卡（转发以太网帧，AP 跑完整协议栈）？

一度倾向 VNET，理由是"AP 也是 NuttX，usrsock 把 socket 语义切成两半"。后来查到 BES 的 Vela 多核板子用的就是 usrsock：`vendor/bes/boards/best2003_ep/aos_evb/configs/ap` 开 `NET_USRSOCK_RPMSG_SERVER` 并跑 Wi‑Fi，`audio` 开 `NET_USRSOCK_RPMSG` 做客户端。于是改为保留 usrsock。

| | usrsock | VNET |
|---|---|---|
| 跨核传什么 | socket 调用和 payload | 以太网帧 |
| TCP ACK、重传 | 在 CP 本地处理 | 每个包都要过核 |
| 大核休眠 | 友好 | 不友好 |
| 多个核共享网络 | 天然支持 | 要桥接或 NAT；STA 只有一个 MAC，桥接会被 AP 丢包 |
| socket 语义 | 部分在本地、部分转发，有缝隙 | 完全原生 |
| 现成实现 | NuttX 树内有，BES 在用 | `rpmsgdrv.c` 在这块板上撞过对称创建死锁 |

选 usrsock 的代价在第 1 条已经看到：请求大小必须装得进 rptun 环。VNET 传的是不超过 MTU 的帧，没有这个问题。另外，`SO_RCVTIMEO`、`SO_SNDTIMEO` 只在 AP 本地生效（`net/socket/setsockopt.c:89-130`），不会转发到 CP。只有在需要 raw socket、抓包这类 usrsock 转发不了的能力，或者跨核吞吐成为瓶颈时，才值得换 VNET。

## 方法上的教训

- **用对照实验切分，不要猜。**
  - 在本机用 Python 按板子的请求头重放：用假 key 得到 401，说明路由层是通的，排除了请求头的问题；用真 key 逐个去掉 `max_tokens`、`system`、`tools`，排除了请求体字段。
  - `date -s` 手动拨时间，排除了"时钟跳变导致卡死"。
  - NSH 里 `ping <域名>`，排除了 DNS 走 usrsock 有问题。
  - 每个实验只回答一个问题，结论才可靠。
- **长度推算有盲区。** 曾经从 TLS 记录长度反推出路径长度是 36 字节，判断路径已经补对了。但拼错的 `cpmpletions` 也是 36 字节，这个推算分不出来。
- **终端要开自动换行**（minicom `Ctrl-A W`）。被截断的日志行先后导致了"看不到 URL"和"看不到断言文件名"两次误判。
- **开发配置建议常开 `STACK_COLORATION`。** 4b 是看到 `ps` 的实际栈用量才坐实的，在那之前只能推断。
- **日志里会有明文 key。** `set_llm` 会把 key 原样回显到串口。抓下来的日志在提交或转发前，要先替换掉 key 和 PSK。
- **我推翻过自己的两个判断。**
  - "usrsock 不转发 `SO_SNDTIMEO`，所以写会卡住"：真正卡住的位置是等 CP 的应答，原因是第 1 条。
  - "UDP `recvfrom` 提前返回"：日志里那些"发完就关"的轮次，其实是 4a 的连通性 ping 超时。
  - 两次都是因为看到的日志不完整，就先下了结论。

## 未解决项

- `vela_tls` 等回复时忙轮询，日志里 `WANT_READ` 出现几千次，期间一直占着 CPU（`packages/ai_agent`）。

# BK7258 AP 侧网络应用复盘（TLS / LLM / NTP）

接在 `bk7258-network-bringup-retrospective.md` 之后：那份解决的是 CP 上 wlan0 从扫描到 ping 通，这份解决的是 AP 上的应用经 usrsock 用这条链路时遇到的问题。

## 现在到哪了

AP 上的 ai_agent 经 RPMsg usrsock 使用 CP 的 NuttX 协议栈：TLS 握手、10 KB 级请求体、LLM 回复、NTP 对时都在板上跑通。`ask` 的端到端耗时约 14 秒，其中大部分是服务端生成时间。

相关提交：

| 仓库 | commit | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| 本仓库 | `7846afc` | TLS 单条记录上限 4096、NTP 守护任务栈 4096、`STACK_COLORATION` |
| 本仓库 | `60776fc` | AP rpmsg 工作队列栈 8192 |
| 本仓库 | `10157a9` | AP `SYSLOG_INTBUFFER` |
| `packages/ai_agent` | `6b48fe3` | `set_llm` 路径补全 |
| `apps`（本地分支 `fix/ntpclient-icmp-timeout`） | `2d34eff73` | ntpclient 连通性 ping 超时，待提上游 PR |

`apps` 那个提交只在本地。`apps` 切回别的分支，AP 上的 NTP 会悄悄失效。

## 根因清单

### 1. TLS 大写入卡死：usrsock 请求占满 rptun 环（`7846afc`）

症状：握手成功，写 10659 字节的请求体时停在 `DIAG net_send calling len=10659`，之后再无输出，也没有报错。

根因：`nuttx/drivers/usrsock/usrsock_rpmsg_server.c:455-519` 收到 sendto 请求的每个分片都 `rpmsg_hold_rx_buffer` 扣住，直到整个请求拼完才释放。AP→CP 方向只有 `VRING_NUM=4` 块、每块约 2032 字节净载，这个请求要 6 块。第 4 块被扣住后 ring 里没有空闲缓冲，AP 在 `rpmsg_get_tx_payload_buffer(wait=true)` 里无限等，CP 永远等不到剩下的分片。CP 只在用完第 `NIOVEC` 个 iov 时才报 `Request too large`，所以连这句报错都没有。

单次请求的真实上限是 `min(NIOVEC, VRING_NUM) × 约 2032` 字节，还要减去同时在发的其他 socket 占用。项目记忆里原来写的"NIOVEC=16，上限约 30 KB"是错的。

修法：`ap-armino/defconfig` 加 `CONFIG_MBEDTLS_SSL_OUT_CONTENT_LEN=4096`，一条 TLS 记录约 4.1 KB，占 3 块。`vela_tls.c` 的写循环本来就处理部分写入，所以 body 不会被截断。`IN_CONTENT_LEN` 保持 16384：服务器可以发 16 KB 的记录，而 CP→AP 方向 CP 会主动分片，没有这个问题。顺带省下约 12 KB RAM。

判据：10638 字节分成 `4117 + 4117 + 2467` 三条记录发出，服务器回包。

### 2. LLM 404：两个独立原因（`6b48fe3`）

第一个是路径补全太死。`cmd_llm.c` 只在路径正好是 `/v1` 时补 `/chat/completions`。`/compatible-mode/v1`、`/api/v3` 都被原样请求，网关返回空 body 的 404。现在的规则是：最后一段是 `v<数字>` 才补；完整路径、`/v1/messages`、`/v1beta` 都不动。规则在 `src/channels/llm_path.h`，主机测试是 `tests/host/test_llm_path.c`。

第二个是拼写错误。有一次 URL 写成了 `chat/cpmpletions`。终端没开自动换行，那一行被截断，看不到。

另外，`/api/v3/responses` 是 Responses API，请求体字段是 `input`。ai_agent 只会生成 Chat Completions 格式（`messages`），所以那次的报错是 400 `unknown field "messages"`，不是 404。

### 3. 正常回复被当成超时

症状：`LLM watchdog: call took 4183107793 ms`，回复已经收到，却被当成超时丢弃。

根因：`vela_tls.c` 发现系统时间早于 2024 年时，会在请求进行中把时钟强制拨到 2026 年。agent 用 `gettimeofday` 计时，差值就变成了约 48 天。只在开机后 NTP 同步之前的第一次请求出现。

修法：根治靠 NTP 在第一次请求前同步好，见下一条。agent 计时改成 `CLOCK_MONOTONIC` 属于上游修改，没有做。

### 4. NTP 从不同步：两个独立根因（`apps` `2d34eff73` + `7846afc`）

症状：`ntpcstatus` 一直是 0 个样本。开网络调试后，有时还会整个 AP 卡死，NSH 不能输入，`[AP] stalled`。

**4a. 连通性检查的 ping 只等 1 毫秒。** ntpclient 每轮先调 `netlib_check_ipconnectivity(NULL, 1, 1)` ping 一下 DNS 服务器，ping 不通就不发 NTP 请求。`icmp_ping` 的超时单位是毫秒：`system/ping/ping.c:47` 默认传 1000 并注释"1 second in milliseconds"，`icmp_ping.c:356` 直接把它交给 `poll`。但 `icmp_ping.h` 的注释写的是 deciseconds，ntpclient 传了 1。实际网络 RTT 是 45–59 ms，几乎每轮都失败。改成 1000，并把头文件注释改为毫秒。

**4b. NTP 守护任务栈溢出。** 守护任务栈只有 2048 字节，它自己做 DNS 解析，`lib_dnsquery.c` 在栈上放 `qname[258]` 加约 512 字节的收发缓冲。开 `STACK_COLORATION` 后 `ps` 显示实际用了 2108 字节，而可用约 1990 字节。偶尔 4a 的 ping 赶上了回包，流程走到 DNS，就会栈溢出，表现为卡死或 panic。改为 `CONFIG_NETUTILS_NTPCLIENT_STACKSIZE=4096`，现在用量 52.7%。

为什么卡死时整个 AP 都不动：守护线程从 `ntpclient.c:1290` 起整个循环都持有 `sched_lock()`。AP 是单核，线程一旦在不阻塞的状态下出问题，其他任务都排不上，包括心跳线程和 NSH。这是 ntpclient 的上游设计，我们没改。

还没处理：`NETUTILS_NTPCLIENT_SERVER` 里 `ntp1.ntsc.ac.cn`、`ntp1.cstnet.cn` 在这个网络上解析不了，现在只靠 `ntp1.aliyun.com`。

### 5. AP 在中断里写 syslog 触发断言（`10157a9`）

症状：在 mailbox 中断里执行 `syslog()` 时，断言在 `semaphore.h:518`。

根因：AP 的 syslog channel 是 RPMsg console。它的写函数要拿 `nxmutex`，中断写和普通写用的是同一个函数（`g_syslog_dev_ops`），没有中断安全的路径。

修法：`CONFIG_SYSLOG_INTBUFFER=y`、`CONFIG_SYSLOG_INTBUFSIZE=1024`。中断里的输出先放进缓冲，回到任务上下文或 panic flush 时再写出去。

剩余风险：缓冲满了以后 NuttX 改为强制直写（`syslog_intbuffer.c` 的溢出分支），又会碰到互斥锁。只有中断里短时间连续写超过 1 KB 才会触发。

### 6. AP rpmsg 工作队列栈接近满（`60776fc`）

console 移到 AP 之后，`ps` 显示 `rpmsg-cp-0` 用了 3588 / 4016 字节（89%）。`CONFIG_RPMSG_WQUEUE_STACKSIZE=8192` 之后是 11.7%。和 4b 是同一类风险，提前处理。

## 设计决策：保留 usrsock，不改 VNET

问题：AP 和 CP 之间用 usrsock（转发 socket 调用），还是用虚拟网卡（转发以太网帧，AP 跑完整协议栈）？

一度倾向 VNET，理由是"AP 也是 NuttX，usrsock 把 socket 语义切成两半"。后来查到 BES 的 Vela 多核板子用的就是 usrsock：`vendor/bes/boards/best2003_ep/aos_evb/configs/ap` 开 `NET_USRSOCK_RPMSG_SERVER` 并跑 Wi‑Fi，`audio` 开 `NET_USRSOCK_RPMSG` 做客户端。于是改为保留 usrsock。

| | usrsock | VNET |
|---|---|---|
| 跨核传什么 | socket 调用和 payload | 以太网帧 |
| TCP ACK、重传 | 在 CP 本地处理 | 每个包都要过核 |
| 大核休眠 | 友好 | 不友好 |
| 多个核共享网络 | 天然支持 | 要桥接或 NAT；STA 只有一个 MAC，桥接会被 AP 丢包 |
| socket 语义 | 部分在本地、部分转发，有缝隙 | 完全原生 |
| 现成实现 | NuttX 树内有，BES 在用 | `rpmsgdrv.c` 在这块板上撞过对称创建死锁 |

选 usrsock 的代价在第 1 条已经看到：请求大小必须装得进 rptun 环。VNET 传的是不超过 MTU 的帧，没有这个问题。另外，`SO_RCVTIMEO`、`SO_SNDTIMEO` 只在 AP 本地生效（`net/socket/setsockopt.c:89-130`），不会转发到 CP。只有在需要 raw socket、抓包这类 usrsock 转发不了的能力，或者跨核吞吐成为瓶颈时，才值得换 VNET。

# One RPMsg buffer is 512 bytes (openamp/rpmsg_virtio.h:27) and a pointer
# ioctl carries its pointee in the request, so the scan buffer has to stay
# under one buffer: 16 (usrsock_request_ioctl_s) + 32 (iwreq) + payload
# must fit. The usrsock server only reassembles sendto fragments, so a
# split ioctl is parsed as a new request and wedges the link. Keep this
# small; the proper fix is ioctl reassembly upstream.
CONFIG_WIRELESS_WAPI_SCAN_MAX_DATA=384

# Cross-core Wi-Fi control plane (chips/bk7258/wlan_ctrl).  rpmsg_char turns
# an RPMsg endpoint into a local /dev/rpmsg-<name> on each core, so the AP
# drives scan/connect without going through usrsock -- whose request buffer
# has to fit one RPMsg message (see the note in
# chips/bk7258/wifi_armino/compat/bk7258_armino_wops.c).
CONFIG_RPMSG_CHAR=y

# The wlan-ctrl control message is 148 bytes (ssid + passphrase + one AP);
# the default MQ_MAXMSGSIZE of 32 made nxmq_alloc_msgq() assert.
CONFIG_MQ_MAXMSGSIZE=256
# --- Display and UI (moved here from the CP, as in Armino) ---
# LCD1 on the SPI1 master: GPIO2=SCK, GPIO4=MOSI, CS=GPIO3, D/C=GPIO5.
# bk7258_spi_hw.c polls the FIFO and attaches no IRQ, so it runs on either
# core; only one core may own the bus, and that is this one now.
CONFIG_BK7258_LCD1_SPI_HW=y
CONFIG_LCD_DEV=y
CONFIG_LCD_JD9853=y

goldfish 模拟器语音闭环验证的关键发现：火山 ASR 返回 403 `[resource_id=volc.streamingasr.common.cn] requested resource not granted`（backend_code 45000030）。

**真根因（修正后）**：不是「app 未开通资源」，而是 **v2/v3 API 不匹配**。账号(api_key `<REDACTED:volc>-...`)在 **新版 v3 豆包大模型语音系统**，但 `volc_asr.c` 用的是旧 v2 接口。

| | v2(旧代码) | v3(正确) |
|---|---|---|
| WS 路径 | `/api/v2/asr` | `/api/v3/sauc/bigmodel_async` |
| 鉴权 | `Authorization: Bearer;{token}` | `X-Api-Key`/`X-Api-Resource-Id`/`X-Api-Connect-Id` 三 header |
| 资源 | `volc.streamingasr.common.cn` | `volc.seedasr.sauc.duration` |

qemu `voice_test_tts 你好` → "TTS failed: -5"(-EIO)的真根因(2026-09-09 盘清):

- **不是网络**:goldfish guest 网络其实一直好的。net_watch 的 QEMU 分支 `network_wifi_reconnect()`(network_manager.c:125-145)本来就 `system("ifup eth0")` + `system("renew eth0")`(renew=DHCP)。实测 eth0=10.0.2.15、`nslookup openspeech.bytedance.com` 解析、`ping 10.0.2.2` 通。之前"ifup 把 IP 清零"的判断是错的。
- **api_key 有效**:`<REDACTED:volc-key>` 能过鉴权(服务器返回 403 code=45000030,不是 401)。
- **真根因**:账号只开通了 **ASR**(`volc.seedasr.sauc.duration`),**没开通 TTS(语音合成)**。三个 TTS 资源全 "requested resource not granted":

| X-Api-Resource-Id | 内部映射 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| `seed-tts-1.0` | `volc.service_type.10029`(代码现值) | not granted |
| `seed-tts-2.0` | `volc.seedtts.default` | not granted |
| `seed-icl-2.0` | `volc.seedicl.default` | not granted |

- **speaker→资源路由**(第三方实现确认):`_mars_bigtts`/`_moon_bigtts`/`ICL_` → `seed-tts-1.0`;`_uranus_bigtts`/`saturn_` → `seed-tts-2.0`;`S_` → `seed-icl-2.0`。默认 speaker `zh_male_beijingxiaoye_emo_v2_mars_bigtts` 含 `_mars_bigtts` → `seed-tts-1.0` ≡ `volc.service_type.10029`,所以**代码里的 resource 其实没错**,纯粹是账号没开通。
- **需要用户**:在火山控制台给该账号开通「语音合成/豆包语音合成」服务,或换一个已开通 TTS 的 api_key。开通后即可 `set_volc_key <key>` 直接验证。

## 已解决(2026-09-09)

用户开通的是**语音合成大模型 2.0(seed-tts-2.0)**,不是 1.0。所以代码要改资源 + 音色:

- `agent_config.h` `AGENT_DOUBAO_TTS_RESOURCE`: `volc.service_type.10029` → `seed-tts-2.0`
- `AGENT_VOICE_DEFAULT_SPEAKER`: `zh_male_beijingxiaoye_emo_v2_mars_bigtts`(1.0) → `zh_male_m191_uranus_bigtts`(2.0,已 curl 实测返回 PCM)
- 2.0 只能用 `*_uranus_bigtts`/`saturn_*` 音色;用 1.0 音色(mars/moon)会报 `55000000 resource ID is mismatched with speaker related resource`。
- 实测通过的 2.0 音色:`zh_female_qingxinnvsheng_uranus_bigtts`、`zh_female_vv_uranus_bigtts`、`zh_male_m191/taocheng/ruyayichen_uranus_bigtts`。
- qemu 验证:`voice_test_tts 你好` → TTS OK 31916 bytes;新增 `voice_test_speak <text>` 命令端到端(beep+流式 TTS+播放)→ Speak done: 0。**#55 #56 全通**。

宿主机 curl 探针:`POST https://openspeech.bytedance.com/api/v3/tts/unidirectional`,header `x-api-key` + `X-Api-Resource-Id`,body `{"req_params":{"text","speaker","audio_params":{"format":"pcm","sample_rate":16000}}}`。成功响应是单个 JSON `{"code":0,"data":"<base64 pcm>"}`;not-granted 是 `{"header":{"code":45000030}}`;音色不匹配是 `{"code":55000000}`。

## 需要你准备的值

| 项 | 必需? | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| Wi-Fi | 必需 | SSID + 密码(WPA2-PSK;建议 2.4G,不要网页认证/企业 802.1X) |
| LLM | 必需 | base URL + 模型名 + API key |
| 火山语音 | 可选(要 PTT/TTS 才需要) | 一个 v3 `api_key`(`set_volc_key`) |
| 代理/DNS | 视网络 | 办公网要代理才需 `set_proxy`;内网域名解析不了才需 `set_dns` |

- **内网 Mify(之前 qemu 验证过)**:
  `set_llm http://model.mify.ai.srv xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro <sk-ya...key>`
  (模型名必须带 `xiaomi/` 前缀;纯 HTTP 80)
- **公网**:`set_llm deepseek <key>` / `openai <key>` / `kimi <key>` / `qwen <key>` / `glm <key>`,
  或自定义 `set_llm https://host/v1 <model> <key>`

语音只需要 `set_volc_key <api_key>`(v3 的 ASR 和 TTS 都用它);`set_volc_asr <app_id> <token> <cluster>` 是旧 v2 遗留,**不用配**。默认音色 `zh_male_m191_uranus_bigtts`。

## 操作顺序

`wapi` 只能在 `nsh-ap>` 执行,现在板子在 `vela>` 下,需要先**物理复位/断电重启**(别在 NSH 里敲裸 `reboot`,会打 Rptun 死锁):

```text

wapi scan
wapi connect "<SSID>" "<密码>"
ifconfig                 # 成功应看到 wlan0 10.0.0.x
ping 223.5.5.5           # 可选,验外网

ai_agent                 # 进 vela>

set_llm http://model.mify.ai.srv xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro <key>
set_volc_key <火山 api_key>        # 可选
config_show              # 确认 Model/LLM Host/API Key 都有值(masked)
net_status               # 应显示 connected + IP
ask 你好                  # 这次应给出正常回复,而不是"未联网"
```

- **密码和 key 请你自己在串口终端里敲**,不要贴到对话里。`set_llm` 那行会原样回显到串口(含 key),这是已知行为;如果我后面抓串口日志,提交前会走 `contest-log-redact` 脱敏。

250	#### F. AP UsageFault 崩溃 → CP panic(2026-10-20 定位并修复)
251	
252	**现象**:`ask 你好` 后只看到 `[agent] Processing message from cli:console`,随即 AP 死:
253	
254	```
255	arm_usagefault: PANIC!!! Usage Fault:
256	arm_usagefault:     CFSR: 01000000 ... (Unaligned access)
257	dump_assert_info: Assertion failed panic: at file: .../arm_m/arm_usagefault.c:114 task: ai_agent
258	[CP] FATAL: Panic by remote core: ap
259	Rptun driver reset remote ap reason: 2
260	```
261	
262	AP 回溯(`sched_dumpstack`)落在 `lv_loop_thread → lv_timer_handler →
263	lv_timer_exec → lv_async_timer_cb → lv_async.c:103`。反汇编 `lv_async_timer_cb`
264	在 `lv_async.c:103` 是 `ldmia.w r2, {r0,r1}`(r2 = `timer->user_data`),
265	ARMv8-M 上只有 LDM/STM 这类多寄存器访问会因未对齐触发 UsageFault —— 也就是
266	**user_data 指针是垃圾值**。
267	
268	**根因**:AP 构建 `CONFIG_LV_USE_OS=0`,LVGL 自身没有任何锁。`lv_timer_create()`
269	(`lv_timer.c:165`)先把新 timer **链进全局链表**,到第 174 行才写 `user_data`;
270	与此同时 LVGL 循环线程正在 `lv_timer_handler()` 遍历同一链表。agent 线程
271	`lv_async_call()`(本次修复又在这条路径上新增了第二个 `lv_async_call`,命中率大增)
272	撞上这个窗口:handler 执行了一个刚链入、字段还没填完的 timer,`timer_cb` 已就绪
273	而 `user_data` 还是堆里的旧垃圾 → `ldmia` 未对齐 → UsageFault → RPTUN 把 AP 复位。
274	
275	**修复**(`packages/ai_agent/src/ui/lvgl_ui_channel.c` 等):
276	- 新增 `lvgl_ui_lock()/lvgl_ui_unlock()`(owner+depth 模拟可重入,本构建未开
277	  `CONFIG_PTHREAD_MUTEX_TYPES`)与加锁版 `lvgl_ui_async_call()`;
278	- `lv_loop_thread()` 在 `lv_timer_handler()` 外围持锁;
279	- 所有跨线程 `lv_async_call()`(lvgl_ui_channel / pet_status_view / standby_view /
280	  particle_flow_view / lvgl_toast / qrcode_display / tool_proxyquickapp)统一改用
281	  `lvgl_ui_async_call()`;`qrcode_display` 的 `lv_timer_create` 也持锁;
282	- 自起 LVGL 时把 loop 线程的创建**挪到 init 末尾**(控件全部建好之后再起 handler
283	  线程),消除启动期同一批 LVGL 全局量的竞争。
284	
285	**复测判据**:烧录含该修复的镜像后,重复 E1(无网 `ask 你好`):
286	串口不再出现 `arm_usagefault` / `Panic by remote core`,应看到
287	`[agent] reply 60 bytes`,8s 后 `[lvgl_ui] idle → pet home screen`,宠物屏文字为
288	`未联网 / 请先连接 Wi-Fi`。
289	
290	**复测结果(2026-10-20 真机,镜像 SHA-256 `a9006cae…9382aeb5`)**:通过。
291	连续 9 次无网 `ask`(6 次连发压测 + 3 次单发)全部走完

296	附带变化:离线时 `lvgl_ui_channel_send()` 跳过 TTS(`network_is_connected()` 门控),
297	所以不再有 `[voice] speak` 和 ~20s 的 `TTS network done` 卡顿,气泡照常入 LVGL 队列。

## Complete workflow
